bills.title: Customs Amendment (Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership Implementation) Bill 2018

name: The majority voted against a motion moved by Labor Senator [Kim Carr](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/kim_carr), which means it failed.
